## Never Lose Your Wonder

When my hearing loss cut too deep into my ability to produce and master music... well, after a couple of years of denial. . that's when I knew I needed to focus more on my visual arts. Yeah, I played plenty of live shows after that, but the tech wasn't there for me to really make that a source of income. I finally accepted the truth.

On that night, I posted this very design on Facebook ([link](https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=10153043816169835&set=a.91897654834.82352.695224834&type=3&theater)). It's bittersweet to look at, and not just because of the moment. Emtastic's comment gets me every time.. . and it's proof how fucked up the universe is that she's no longer with us. So fuck alotta _that_ bullshit! I still hold to my words that I wrote. I still hold to my wonder in spite of all the darkness.

_<font face="Times New Roman">Never -- not for anything nor for anyone -- never lose your wonder. There is magic in the space between worlds.</font>_

The design's since become the figurehead of my fractalscapes. You'll find it on YouTube videos, including my own ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jtDjetBDrmc)), and it remains one of my best-sellers on Redbubble ([link](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/20957989)). I returned to the design a second time, turning it into a fractalplanet that's since become known as "The Little Astronaut" ([Redbubble](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/24198805)) -- itself a play on one of my favorite books -- _The Little Prince!_ Then it was finally immortalized in my large-scale "[Celestial Return](celestial-return)" fractal mural.

I hope the words reach others. . that even if it reminds only one person to look up at the stars with awe in their heart, that I've accomplished what I set out to do.

_Never... never lose your wonder!_

## Lighthouse 42

_aka, "The Lighthouse at the End of the Universe"_

This is an example of one of my remixes outperforming the original design, as it's the fractal planet version of my fractalscape "On the Horizon of the Infinite" ([Redbubble](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/20958604)). It's also the third and final planet in my large-scale "[Celestial Return](celestial-return)" fractal mural, appropriately sitting at the very top of the three planets in the main mural itself. "Lighthouse 42," the planet itself, is available on prints and more on Redbubble ([link](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/34557505)).

From **Nietzsche**, on _the horizon of the infinite_:

_<font face="Times New Roman">We have left the land and have embarked. We have burned our bridges behind us -- indeed, we have gone farther and destroyed the land behind us. Now, little ship, look out! Beside you is the ocean: to be sure, it does not always roar, and at times it lies spread out like silk and gold and reveries of graciousness. But hours will come when you will realize that it is infinite and that there is nothing more awesome than infinity. Oh, the poor bird that felt free and now strikes the walls of this cage! Woe, when you feel homesick for the land as if it had offered more freedom -- and there is no longer any "land".</font>_

## Deep Space Dreamer

Featured in _Marq Magazine_ and the two-page full-art centerfold for my book "[Spectral Iteration](spectral-iteration)", this has become one of my most iconic pieces to-date. When I first designed this, NASA had just discovered seven earth-sized exoplanets in orbit around a single star, with the certainty of life on at least one of them. Do you know how far they are away from us? 40 light years. _40!_ We could send a message using lasers, and it would cost us less than a century to make the round-trip to open up their response and read it.

This particular design was built on the largest exoplanet that we've ever discovered (at the time) -- Kepler-62e. We've found larger since that time. The multiverse is vast and full of potential. The design itself nearly killed my computer to make it, as I had to process and render small parts of it at a time -- 16ths to be exact... then stitching them all together into the final work that you see before you. Prints and other merchandise are available on Redbubble ([link](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/21239177)).

## Tik-Tok's Time Contraption

_aka, "Steampunk Gearball"_

When I created the time contraption back in 2018, the app TikTok wasn't a "thang" -- Tik-Tok is a character from **L Frank Baum's** series about the _Land of Oz_. I consider Tik-Tok, himself, to be a major source for the modern steampunk aesthetic. So I took my "[Bending Space](fractal-gifs)" fractal GIF and made a full gear system out of it, as if we're inside of a massive clock, so large that even planets are orbiting within the great clockwork contraption. In many ways, it's not too different than how I see the "reality" in which we currently reside.

Then there is one more inspiration for the piece, a quote by **Lorien** in _Babylon 5_:

_<font face="Times New Roman">Tick, tock. Tick, tock. Always running out of time. Yours is almost used up. You're between seconds, lost in the infinite possibilities between tick and tock. Tick, you're alive. Tock.. Well, it was a good life, but a short one. Tick, tock, tick, tock, tick...</font>_

\[[Prints + More on Redbubble](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/31908127)\]

##### Endless Sunset

_aka, "Elysian Fields"_

For fans of this piece, _I see you!_ Lol, and I know.. . I know. You just saw it and said to yourselves, "Finally!" It's because I already put up an entire entry on my "Fractal Sky" designs [right here on the site](fractal-sky), which covered the advent of this design and leads into my whole "Shattered Glass Fractals" series. But! There is one thing.. . because this specific piece has another source of inspiration, a poem by **Lewis Carroll** (from _Through the Looking Glass_):

*   A boat, beneath a sunny sky
*   Lingering onward dreamily
*   In an evening of July --

~ <3 ~

*   Children three that nestle near,
*   Eager eye and willing ear
*   Pleased a simple tale to hear --

~ <3 ~

*   Long has paled that sunny sky:
*   Echoes fade and memories die:
*   Autumn frosts have slain July.
content.html:
~ <3 ~
Still she haunts me, phantomwise
Alice moving under skies
Never seen by waking eyes.
~ <3 ~
Children yet, the tale to hear,
Eager eye and willing ear,
Lovingly shall nestle near.
~ <3 ~
In a Wonderland they lie,
Dreaming as the days go by,
Dreaming as the summers die:
~ <3 ~
Ever drifting down the stream --
Lingering in the golden gleam --
Life what is it but a dream?
~ <3 ~

## 𝕋𝐡𝐞 ℙ𝐢𝐥𝐠𝐫𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐠𝐞; 𝐚𝐤𝐚, 𝔸𝐲𝐚𝐡𝐮𝐚𝐬𝐜𝐚

_Because there are some journeys you can take while still living that you never quite come back from. This is certainly one of them._

Note that, for myself, so far in this current life I have only journeyed with the crystalline form of DMT. I'm told that this is why it is highly angular and nearly gridlocked in its geometry. There will come a day when I travel to meet the serpent itself, in order to fly with it up and through the jungles. Slowly the world moves more towards that direction, as I'm not the only one who seeks out ways to move from plane to plane.

This is just but one key to unlock the one thousand and one doors of existence.

The Pilgrimage is available on prints and more on Redbubble ([link](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/53882337)) and is intended to be seen and experienced in altered states.

## Shambhala

_aka, "Seventh Heaven"; aka, "Himalayan Heavens"_

Mountains hold their own sense of wonder for me. Those who know me know well my hatred for and repulsion from the cold. It is the treasure atop those peaks that draws me in and keeps me climbing. You need to see it though. Yes, you, you right here reading this. If you haven't yet seen the world fall away, curving downward across the horizon to truly FEEL the great sphere upon which we reside, to feel your small place in the eye itself.. . there's nothing like it. Then on those rare times when I've camped atop the peak, an entirely new reality wakes up at sunset. The stars come out... and while the world itself is still bathed in the final light of the dying sun. Suddenly, heaven and earth are connected, with the great celestial gears glimmering above and the golden, dying colors of the land folding outward beneath. Heaven is not a far-off experience in some other world. _It is here. It is now!_

_<font face="Times New Roman">Can you tell me the way to Shambhala? To the secret "Seventh Heaven" of the Himalayas?</font>_

\[[Prints + More on Redbubble](https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/52769772)\]

## Fractalscapes: To Coin a Phrase

When I first opened my [store on Zazzle](https://www.zazzle.com/fractalscapes), back in 2016, I checked if anyone was using the word "fractalscapes" online. At that time, Google came up empty for the word. _It was mine!_ So I opened the store and started using it in my surreal fractal arts. A decade later, and times have changed. The word's certainly entered the zeitgeist. Other than having the earliest digital fingerprint on the word itself, it's now a part of the public. But it started with me. Among a handful of other accomplishments, it remains a lasting part of my legacy in the fractal art community.

* * *

### Extended Exploration

If you missed them, definitely check out my "[Celestial Return](celestial-return)" fractal mural and the "[Ship for All Destinations](destination-everywhere)" fractalscape. Also, I often work surreal elements into my [pop art fractals](other-pop-art), with many of them now appearing all around the internet and at art shows.
